svg.title: Freeman Barn corrected 2026 measured East elevation
svg.desc: Corrected field record showing the East front elevation, North Mail Pouch gable, three front windows, centered barn door, field-measured footprint geometry, verified roof measurements, and the North, South, and West opening schedule.

g.text: Roof surface, ridge to eave: 21′-0″ each plane
Gable rise, reveal/eave line to peak: 13′-0″
Upper trim boards to bottom of soffit: 2′-0″
Arrangement: 1 south/left of door • 2 north/right of door
